generation_history.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: source-bounded Bible Journey instructional illustration, Exodus 12:7–11 only
Input images: Image 1: style reference only; match its cinematic, richly painted historical realism, warm amber natural palette, layered light, textured earth and cloth, and detailed brushwork. Do not copy its river, figures, or composition.
Primary request: Illustrate the household instructions in Exodus 12:7–11. This is an illustrative view of the prescribed household arrangement, not a claim to depict a documented or enacted Passover event.
Scene/backdrop: A modest ancient household interior in Egypt, seen through a clear doorway so both the marked doorframe and meal are visible. Keep all setting details generic because the passage does not specify a house design or site.
Subject: Show the two side posts and upper door post with a modest, restrained red marking, not gore. Within the house, an unnamed household eats roasted lamb with unleavened bread and bitter herbs. The people are dressed and ready as instructed: garments gathered at the waist, simple sandals on their feet, staffs held in hand. Their mood is alert and purposeful, with the meal still the central action.
Style/medium: Painterly cinematic historical realism matching the supplied Bible-scene reference; believable human proportions, natural cloth and wood textures, painterly but realistic, not photorealistic and not fantasy.
Composition/framing: Wide 1536x1024 landscape. Keep the doorway and marked lintel on the left, and the meal and ready household in the left/center 65 percent so a reader overlay on the right does not obscure the source subjects. Make both the red doorpost marks and the meal clearly visible for separate source-linked hotspots.
Lighting/mood: Quiet evening lamplight with warm amber tones and soft shadows; sober, domestic, and purposeful rather than theatrical.
Constraints: Treat all visible figures as unnamed illustrative household members; no asserted likenesses. Do not show a death angel, any divine person, a plague, a death, a slaughter, a future departure, a caravan, or people leaving the house. No map, no text, no interface, no pins, no watermark. No blood except the modest red doorframe marking. Do not add ritual objects, architecture, or exact historical claims not stated in the source.
generation_history.disposition: Refined because the first red door-frame marks were broader and more saturated than requested.

generation_history.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: source-bounded Bible Journey narrative painting, Exodus 19:16–19 only
Input images: Image 1: style reference only; match its cinematic, richly painted historical realism, warm natural palette, layered sky, textured terrain, and detailed brushwork. Do not copy its river, buildings, figures, or composition.
Primary request: Create a wide landscape illustration of the events on Mount Sinai in Exodus 19:16–19.
Scene/backdrop: Morning at a generic rugged mountain in the wilderness. The passage names Mount Sinai but does not describe its exact shape, geology, or modern location; keep the mountain and terrain illustrative.
Subject: A thick cloud covers the mountain summit; smoke rises from the mount like a furnace, fire is visible upon it, and lightning cuts through the cloud. At a distance near the mountain’s lower part, a gathered people stand trembling. Moses is a small, modestly dressed figure near them at the base, facing the mountain. Show the mountain as trembling only through subtle atmospheric motion or falling dust, not through invented destruction.
Style/medium: Painterly, cinematic historical realism matching the supplied Bible-scene reference; natural forms, finely rendered smoke, cloud and stone, visible brush texture, rich but restrained atmosphere, not fantasy spectacle.
Composition/framing: Wide 1536x1024 landscape. Keep the mountain, smoke/fire, lightning, and gathered people in the left and center 65 percent so a reader overlay on the right does not cover the subjects. The mountain should fill the left-center; the people and Moses should be readable as a separate small group near its lower base.
Lighting/mood: Early morning under storm-dark cloud, muted stone and warm firelight, dramatic thunderous atmosphere without apocalyptic exaggeration.
Constraints: Do not show any humanoid divinity, face, body, silhouette in the cloud, tablets, golden calf, altar, or other later event. No visible voice or speech text; no invented trumpet player or instrument. No people climbing the mountain; keep them at a distance near its lower part. No map, labels, text, interface, pins, watermark, modern objects, or specific geographic landmarks. Moses’s appearance is illustrative, not a claimed portrait.
generation_history.disposition: Refined to remove a staff from the small figure at the mountain base because it is not stated in this passage.

hotspots.title: Fire and smoke cover Mount Sinai
hotspots.note: Verse 18 reports the mountain covered with smoke because the LORD descended upon it in fire and says it quaked greatly. Verse 19 reports the increasing trumpet sound and an answer by voice; no voice or divine form is depicted. Mountain shape, fire, and smoke appearance are illustrative.

hotspots.title: The people stand at the lower part of the mountain
hotspots.note: Verse 16 says the people trembled in the camp; verse 17 says Moses brought them out and they stood at the lower part of the mount. Their appearance and the composition of the crowd are illustrative, not portraits or an exact census.
